pain_point: Tired of landlord controlling their space - My landlord won't let me modify the space for my business needs. I want my own place.
headline_pain: How Much Has Your Landlord Cost You?
primary_text: "My landlord won't let me modify the space." Now add up what that's really costing you. The contract you lost because you couldn't install the right equipment. The efficiency you're missing because the layout doesn't suit your workflow. The rent increases you cop every year with nothing to show for it. Owning changes everything. These new Truganina warehouses are purpose-built for small business owner-occupiers. Flexible layouts, high clearance, and the freedom to fit out however you need. Near Princes Freeway with West Gate Tunnel access. Stop funding someone else's retirement. Fund your own.
description: Purpose-built for owner-occupiers who need full operational control
